- ✅ Cross-layer coherence (Python↔JS↔SQL)

- ✅ TDD-based fix suggestions

S1: Core review engine + diff parsing (1 day, 20 tests)
S2: LENS integration - security & intelligence (1.5 days, 25 tests)
S3: Company domain compliance (1 day, 20 tests)
S4: Cross-layer coherence validation (1 day, 18 tests)
